summary: The table presents a financial performance overview for a company, comparing key metrics across three periods: September 30, 2024, September 30, 2023, and June 30, 2024. It includes revenues, cost of sales, gross profit, operating expenses, operating profit, net profit, and earnings per share (EPS). The table also shows year-over-year (YoY) and quarter-over-quarter (QoQ) growth percentages. Notable insights include a 3.7% YoY increase in revenues from 2023 to 2024 and a 3.8% QoQ increase from June to September 2024. Operating profit and net profit also show positive growth trends, with net profit before minority interest increasing by 3.6% YoY.
